name: travel-agent
description: Modular travel research, evidence, decision and fulfillment skills for Travel Agent V1.

interface.shortDescription: Research and shape executable travel plans.
interface.longDescription: Travel Agent coordinates social discovery, official travel providers, evidence verification and shared trip decisions without allowing Skills to mutate trip state directly.
defaultPrompt: Research this trip using social discovery and verified travel sources.
Compare these travel options and explain the important tradeoffs.
